2.12.13
Image.Top
The Image.Top element specifies the distance of an Image from the top of the image container,
such as a Rectangle or Body. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value MUST be
an RdlSize.
Following is the parent element of the Image.Top element.
Parent elements
Image
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Image.Top element.
 <xsd:element name="Top" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
